_comment: The LXR's glossary: a readable name and a one-line help per firmware text id (TEXT_*), shared by every voice's parameter of that name. tools/registry.py merges it into registry/lxr.json's tables.

TEXT_WAVEFORM.name: Waveform
TEXT_WAVEFORM.help: The oscillator's wave: sine is round, triangle soft, saw bright, rect hollow; noise; PWM.

TEXT_COARSE.name: Coarse tune
TEXT_COARSE.help: The oscillator's pitch in semitones: the basic tuning of the drum.

TEXT_NOISE.name: Noise color
TEXT_NOISE.help: The noise's frequency: low is a dark rumble, high a bright hiss.

TEXT_MIX.name: Noise/osc mix
TEXT_MIX.help: Balance between the noise and the tone: the snare's rattle against its body.

TEXT_MOD_OSC1_FREQ.name: Mod osc 1 freq
TEXT_MOD_OSC1_FREQ.help: Frequency of the first modulating oscillator: changes the metallic color.

TEXT_MOD_OSC2_FREQ.name: Mod osc 2 freq
TEXT_MOD_OSC2_FREQ.help: Frequency of the second modulating oscillator: changes the metallic color.

TEXT_MOD_OSC1_GAIN.name: Mod osc 1 depth
TEXT_MOD_OSC1_GAIN.help: How strongly the first modulating oscillator bends the tone: more is harsher.

TEXT_MOD_OSC2_GAIN.name: Mod osc 2 depth
TEXT_MOD_OSC2_GAIN.help: How strongly the second modulating oscillator bends the tone: more is harsher.

TEXT_FILTER_F.name: Filter cutoff
TEXT_FILTER_F.help: The filter's frequency: lower is darker (low-pass) or thinner (high-pass).

TEXT_FILTER_RESO.name: Resonance
TEXT_FILTER_RESO.help: Emphasis at the cutoff: a ringing, whistling edge when high.

TEXT_ATTACK.name: Attack
TEXT_ATTACK.help: Time for the hit to reach full volume: 0 is a sharp click, more a soft swell.

TEXT_DECAY.name: Decay
TEXT_DECAY.help: How long the hit rings out: short for tight drums, long for booming ones.

TEXT_DECAY_CLOSED.name: Closed decay
TEXT_DECAY_CLOSED.help: How long the closed hihat rings.

TEXT_DECAY_OPEN.name: Open decay
TEXT_DECAY_OPEN.help: How long the open hihat rings (the closed one cuts it off).

TEXT_EG_SLOPE.name: Envelope slope
TEXT_EG_SLOPE.help: Shape of the decay: linear is even, exponential drops fast then lingers.

TEXT_REPEAT.name: Repeat count
TEXT_REPEAT.help: Retriggers the envelope several times per hit: claps and flams.

TEXT_PITCH_DECAY.name: Pitch decay
TEXT_PITCH_DECAY.help: How fast the pitch falls after the hit: short is a click, long a laser drop.

TEXT_MOD_AMOUNT.name: Pitch drop
TEXT_MOD_AMOUNT.help: How far the pitch starts above its tuning: the thump of a kick.

TEXT_FM_AMOUNT.name: FM amount
TEXT_FM_AMOUNT.help: How strongly the modulator changes the tone: metallic, bell-like, noisy.

TEXT_FM_FREQ.name: FM frequency
TEXT_FM_FREQ.help: The modulator's pitch against the drum's: changes the FM color.

TEXT_PAN.name: Pan
TEXT_PAN.help: Where the voice sits between left and right.

TEXT_DRIVE.name: Overdrive
TEXT_DRIVE.help: Distorts the voice: warmth at first, then crunch.

TEXT_SAMPLE_RATE.name: Sample rate
TEXT_SAMPLE_RATE.help: Lowers the voice's sample rate: gritty, lo-fi, 8-bit aliasing.

TEXT_FREQ_LFO.name: LFO rate
TEXT_FREQ_LFO.help: Speed of this voice's LFO (or its division of the tempo with clock sync).

TEXT_MOD_LFO.name: LFO amount
TEXT_MOD_LFO.help: How strongly the LFO moves its destination.

TEXT_FILTER_DRIVE.name: Filter drive
TEXT_FILTER_DRIVE.help: Drives the filter's input: thicker and grittier, especially with resonance.

TEXT_MODE.name: Osc mode
TEXT_MODE.help: FM: the second oscillator modulates the first. Mix: the two are mixed.

TEXT_VEL_MOD_VOL.name: Vel to volume
TEXT_VEL_MOD_VOL.help: On: harder hits are louder. Off: every hit at the same level.

TEXT_VEL_AMT.name: Vel amount
TEXT_VEL_AMT.help: How much velocity changes the destination parameter below.

TEXT_VEL_DEST.name: Vel destination
TEXT_VEL_DEST.help: The parameter that velocity changes, e.g. decay or filter cutoff.

TEXT_WAVE_LFO.name: LFO wave
TEXT_WAVE_LFO.help: The LFO's shape: sine, triangle, saw up or down, square, random, exp.

TEXT_TARGET_VOICE_LFO.name: LFO voice
TEXT_TARGET_VOICE_LFO.help: The voice whose parameter this LFO moves (1-6).

TEXT_RETRIGGER_LFO.name: LFO retrigger
TEXT_RETRIGGER_LFO.help: Restarts the LFO when that voice plays: every hit gets the same motion.

TEXT_SYNC_LFO.name: LFO clock sync
TEXT_SYNC_LFO.help: Locks the LFO to the tempo, as a note length; off: it runs free.

TEXT_OFFSET_LFO.name: LFO start phase
TEXT_OFFSET_LFO.help: Where in its cycle the LFO starts on a retrigger.

TEXT_FILTER_TYPE.name: Filter type
TEXT_FILTER_TYPE.help: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, peak; off bypasses the filter.

TEXT_TRANSIENT_VOLUME.name: Click volume
TEXT_TRANSIENT_VOLUME.help: Level of the short click at the start of the hit: the attack's snap.

TEXT_TRANSIENT_WAVE.name: Click sample
TEXT_TRANSIENT_WAVE.help: Which click starts the hit: snap, click, tick, kick, rim and others.

TEXT_TRANSIENT_FREQ.name: Click pitch
TEXT_TRANSIENT_FREQ.help: Playback speed of the click: higher is shorter and brighter.

TEXT_AUDIO_OUT.name: Output
TEXT_AUDIO_OUT.help: Where the voice goes: stereo 1 or 2, a single side, or the FX bus.

TEXT_PWM.name: Pulse width
TEXT_PWM.help: The rect wave's duty cycle: thinner or hollower.

TEXT_FX_TYPE.name: FX type
TEXT_FX_TYPE.help: The effect (or its variant): drive, ring modulator, compressor, delay.

TEXT_FX_ROUTING.name: FX output
TEXT_FX_ROUTING.help: Where the FX bus goes: stereo output 1 or 2, or a single side.

TEXT_FX_DRY_WET.name: FX dry/wet
TEXT_FX_DRY_WET.help: Balance between the voices sent to the FX bus and the effect.

TEXT_FX_DIST_DRIVE.name: FX drive
TEXT_FX_DIST_DRIVE.help: How hard the effect is driven.

TEXT_FX_COLOR.name: FX color
TEXT_FX_COLOR.help: The effect's character (depends on the FX type).

TEXT_FX_RATIO.name: Comp ratio
TEXT_FX_RATIO.help: How hard the compressor squeezes loud hits: 1:1 none, 8:1 heavy.
